chunks: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al-Husayn, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ali Bin Asbat, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him عليه السلام, “When does the Imam recognize his Imamate and when does the command come to its end with him?” He عليه السلام said, “In the last moment of the life of the first.”

key_terms.آخِرِ: the final part or last moment
key_terms.إِمَامَتَهُ: his office and authority as Imam
key_terms.الْأَمْرُ: the command or divinely entrusted authority
key_terms.الْأَوَّلِ: the former Imam, the one before him
key_terms.حَيَاةِ: the life span of the previous Imam
key_terms.دَقِيقَةٍ: a moment or brief final interval

ai.seo_question: When does the Imam recognize that the Imamate has passed to him?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the succeeding Imam comes to know his Imamate and the transfer of the command at the final moment of the previous Imam’s life. It emphasizes the precise and divinely ordered transmission of Imamate within the line of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
